name: @fraylabs/burr
description: Fast local browser and assembly interference checker for CAD models.

scripts.check:static: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --locked --bin burr --all-features -- -D warnings -D clippy::dbg_macro -D clippy::todo -D clippy::unimplemented -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used -D clippy::undocumented_unsafe_blocks -D clippy::missing_safety_doc && cargo clippy --locked --tests --all-features -- -D warnings -D clippy::dbg_macro -D clippy::todo -D clippy::unimplemented
scripts.check:core: cargo test --locked && cargo run --locked --quiet -- --version && node --check scripts/check-viewer.mjs && npm run check:viewer
scripts.check: npm run check:static && npm run check:core
